title: Great traverse of Vietnam in 21 days
pace: North, caves, coast, then the south
summary: Hanoi, Sapa, Ha Long, Ninh Binh, Phong Nha, Hue, Hoi An, Da Lat, Ho Chi Minh City, and Can Tho. Best February to April.

days.title: Day 1 — Hanoi
days.body: Land in Hanoi and walk the Old Quarter.

days.title: Day 2 — Night train
days.body: Board the night train to Sa Pa.

days.title: Day 3 — Sapa
days.body: See the stone church and Cat Cat.

days.title: Day 4 — Fansipan
days.body: Ride to Fansipan if the ridge is clear.

days.title: Day 5 — Back to Hanoi
days.body: Return to Hanoi.

days.title: Day 6 — Ha Long
days.body: Take a day boat on Ha Long Bay.

days.title: Day 7 — Ninh Binh
days.body: Travel to Ninh Binh.

days.title: Day 8 — Trang An
days.body: Take the Trang An boat. An adult over 1.3 m is 300,000 đồng.

days.title: Day 9 — Dong Hoi
days.body: Travel toward Dong Hoi.

days.title: Day 10 — Phong Nha Cave
days.body: Visit Phong Nha Cave, about 2.5 hours, 150,000 VND plus the boat.

days.title: Day 11 — Paradise Cave
days.body: Visit Paradise Cave. The ticket is 270,000 VND, buggy included.

days.title: Day 12 — Hue
days.body: Travel to Hue.

days.title: Day 13 — Hue Citadel
days.body: Visit the citadel.

days.title: Day 14 — Hoi An
days.body: Travel to Hoi An.

days.title: Day 15 — Hoi An
days.body: Stay in the old town or take An Bang.

days.title: Day 16 — Da Lat
days.body: Travel to Da Lat.

days.title: Day 17 — Da Lat
days.body: See Datanla and Truc Lam.

days.title: Day 18 — Ho Chi Minh City
days.body: Travel to Ho Chi Minh City.

days.title: Day 19 — War Remnants
days.body: Visit the War Remnants Museum.

days.title: Day 20 — Can Tho
days.body: Travel to Can Tho.

days.title: Day 21 — Cai Rang
days.body: Be at Cai Rang at dawn.

seoTitle: Vietnam in 21 days, north to south
seoDescription: Hanoi to Can Tho in 21 days, with Sapa, Ha Long, Ninh Binh, Phong Nha, Hue, Hoi An, and Da Lat.
